channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Fondation Francois Schneider: Talents Contemporains 16th Edition - Water
item.description: Fondation Francois Schneider · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · EUR 15,000 per laureate (merit prize plus acquisition of the work; EUR 8,000 when the work is part of a multiple edition, e.g. photo or video); up to 7 laureates. Sculpture and installation projects can additionally receive up to EUR 50,000 in production assistance. No entry fee stated.

item.title: Judson-Morrissey Excellence in New Media Award 2026 (BIPOC students)
item.description: New Media Caucus · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Multiple unrestricted awards of varying amounts up to USD 500 each, funded through donor contributions. Awardees are also featured in an NMC Header/Footer Gallery exhibition and a digitally published interview. Free to apply.

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.

item.title: Bertha Artivism Awards 2027
item.description: Bertha Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per one-year activist-art project. Free to apply.

item.title: LOEWE FOUNDATION: Craft Prize 2027
item.description: LOEWE FOUNDATION · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 50,000 for the winning entry. No application fee.

item.title: Movies that Matter Festival 2027: Film Submissions
item.description: Movies that Matter · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Cash prizes: EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Documentary award (winner also becomes eligible for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature), EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Fiction award, and EUR 1,500 Shorts award; further competitions (Activist Lens, Justice Frame, Dutch Focus, Education Award, Audience Award) publish no amounts. SUBMISSION FEE: EUR 25 until 30 September 2026, EUR 35 late fee 1 October to 1 November 2026; fee waivers only in very exceptional cases.

item.title: World of WearableArt (WOW) Awards Competition 2027 (Wellington, New Zealand)
item.description: World of WearableArt · deadline 11 Feb 2027 · Over NZD 200,000 in prizes across 25 awards. Per the published 2026 prize schedule: Supreme WOW Award NZD 30,000, runner-up NZD 15,000, section winners NZD 8,000 each. No entry fee.

item.title: Arts Convergences Video Prize, 6th edition (short films on mental illness)
item.description: Arts Convergences, in partnership with Thanks for Nothing · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 total: Grand Prize EUR 2,000, Jury Prize EUR 1,500, Public Choice Prize EUR 1,500 (online vote). Additional prizes may be awarded. No entry fee.
